rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Floribunda.
Registration name: Wekbijou
Exhibition name: Koko Loco
rows.Origin:
Bred by Christian Bédard (United States, 2008).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2012 as 'Koko Loco'.
rows.Bloom: Coffee, ages to lavender . Milky chocolate suffusing to lavender. Mild fragrance. 40 to 64 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered to cupped bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, rounded. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 41" to 4'7" (105 to 140cm). Width: 30" to 35" (75 to 90cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7a and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden.
